purpose: Fit one reusable spatiotemporal GP to all available aligned real observations
scaling: Fit input and temperature standardization on all 980 observations
restart_selection: Lowest final negative training marginal log likelihood
clock_assumption: User accepts synchronized HOBO/GPS clocks and zero additional offset
scope: Full-data parameter fit only, no independent test set. Previous held-out results remain separate. No Dashboard or Intel observations or pretrained weights are used.
